Evaluate an expression with a temporarily changed working directory

Source: R/config.R
mstargetr_with_dir.Rd

Internal helper that changes the working directory, evaluates expr, and restores the original directory on exit. Equivalent to withr::with_dir but implemented without a withr dependency at this specific call site so it can be used safely during package initialisation before withr is attached.

Usage

mstargetr_with_dir(new_dir, expr)

Arguments

new_dir

Target working directory.

expr

Expression to evaluate.

Value

The value of expr.

Details

Note on lazy-eval semantics: expr is a promise that is force()-d after the directory has been changed (and the on.exit restore has been registered). The caller's working directory at call-time is therefore the directory in which expr is evaluated — this is intentional and matches the behaviour of withr::with_dir. Guarantees the original working directory is restored even if expr errors or the user interrupts.
